commit_message: Add ADR0126 Timeline foundation on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Replays the validated ADR0126 Timeline foundation onto the exact current-main baseline through the canonical connector producer and Dispatcher path.

This foundation establishes the neutral Timeline clock/schedule/player model, stable IDs and persistence, typed Timeline authoring and diagnostics, shared transactional authoring service, CLI/MCP capability integration, and common camera-selection override groundwork. The first-release task remains Draft and will continue with production runtime composition, Project Rust integration, the dedicated Sequencer Editor, persistent production-semantics preview, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation.

## Scope

- current-main baseline only
- preserves the seven required first-release track families: Animation, Transform/Property, Camera Cut, Event, Audio, VFX, and Prefab
- reuses ADR0122 production audio ownership; no Timeline-specific audio backend
- does not merge automatically
